what_it_is.prose: Kalyani Strategic Systems Limited (KSSL) is the wholly-owned defence subsidiary of Bharat Forge Limited (BSE: 500495, NSE: BHARATFORG), headquartered in Pune. KSSL is one of India's first dedicated private-sector missile sub-system and artillery manufacturing facilities. As of 31 March 2026, KSSL had a defence order book of ₹10,961 crore (3-4 years revenue visibility), with FY26 new orders of ₹4,814 crore. Bharat Forge consolidated FY26 revenue was ₹16,812 crore (+11.2% YoY), of which the defence segment contributed ₹1,562 crore. KSSL's flagship programme is the ATAGS (Advanced Towed Artillery Gun System, 155mm/52 calibre), co-developed with DRDO and TASL — KSSL received a ₹4,140 crore contract in March 2025 for 184 guns (60% of the ₹6,900 crore MoD deal for 307 guns total, with TASL supplying the remaining 123). Other artillery products include the MArG-52 (Mounted Artillery Gun 155mm/52), which has been offered to the US Army for the Mobile Tactical Cannon (MTC) programme — making KSSL the first Indian company to win a US Army artillery bid; the Bharat-52 (155mm/52 calibre towed howitzer); the Garuda-105 (105mm field gun with soft recoil, partnered with AM General and Mandus Group for global export); and the Mountain Artillery Gun — Extended Range (MAG-ER). KSSL has a $155.5 million export order from 2022 for 155mm truck-mounted howitzers to a friendly foreign country. The company unveiled the SIMHA 4x4 Multi-Role Protected Vehicle at Eurosatory in June 2026. KSSL's Air Defence products include the CIWS, the Army AD Gun (replacement of L-70 and ZU-23), and the SPIKE ATGM (manufactured under licence from Rafael Advanced Defense Systems).

faq.question: What is KSSL's role in the ATAGS programme?
faq.answer: Kalyani Strategic Systems Limited (KSSL) is the prime contractor for 184 of the 307 ATAGS (Advanced Towed Artillery Gun System, 155mm/52 calibre) guns contracted by the Indian Ministry of Defence in March 2025. The KSSL share is ₹4,140 crore (60% of the ₹6,900 crore MoD deal); Tata Advanced Systems Limited (TASL) supplies the remaining 123 guns. ATAGS was co-developed by DRDO's ARDE laboratory with KSSL and TASL as manufacturing partners.

faq.question: What is the MArG-52 and why is it significant for KSSL exports?
faq.answer: The MArG-52 (Mounted Artillery Gun, 155mm/52 calibre) is a KSSL-designed truck-mounted howitzer that has been offered to the US Army for the Mobile Tactical Cannon (MTC) programme. KSSL is the first Indian company to win a US Army artillery bid, marking a milestone for Indian defence exports. The MArG-52 represents KSSL's push beyond towed guns (Bharat-52) into self-propelled and mounted platforms.

faq.question: What is KSSL's defence order book and FY26 financial performance?
faq.answer: KSSL's defence order book stood at ₹10,961 crore as of 31 March 2026 (3-4 years revenue visibility), with FY26 new orders of ₹4,814 crore. Bharat Forge consolidated FY26 revenue was ₹16,812 crore (+11.2% YoY), of which the defence segment contributed ₹1,562 crore. KSSL's SIMHA 4x4 Multi-Role Protected Vehicle was unveiled at Eurosatory in June 2026, when the order book crossed ₹11,000 crore.
